placements.evidence: riftdecks.com RQ Hartford Finals Standings: '1st 14-1-1 Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman by Factor'; corroborated by riftbound.gg ('crowned Master Yi ... Winner with 14-1-1') and rift.yomis-place.de overall standings (#1 FactorElo, Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman, 14-1-1).
riftdecks.com '2nd 13-2-1 Diana, Scorn of the Moon by bsweitz'; riftbound.gg ('Diana ... Finalist with 13-2-1'); yomis-place #2 bsweitzElo.
riftdecks.com '3rd 12-1-2 Ezreal, Prodigal Explorer by Bradykin'; riftbound.gg ('Ezreal ... Top 4 with 12-1-2'); yomis-place #3 BradykinElo.
riftdecks.com '4th 12-2-1 Diana, Scorn of the Moon by linsanity'; yomis-place #4 linsanityElo.
riftdecks.com 5th 11-2-1 Diana by ASC Evansrhim; yomis-place #5.
placements.name_note: Places 5-8 are all 11-2-1; riftdecks and yomis-place agree on 5/7/8 but differ at 6 (riftdecks: Lux/CTCG Relivia; yomis-place: Irelia/guubums). Ordering is the source's tiebreaker presentation.

placements.evidence: riftdecks.com 6th 11-2-1 Lux, Lady of Luminosity by CTCG Relivia. (yomis-place overall standings list Irelia/guubums at #6 instead — bracket vs Swiss-points difference.)
riftdecks.com 7th 11-2-1 Annie, Dark Child by Prismaticismism; riftbound.gg lists Annie in Top 8 (11-2-1); yomis-place #7.
riftdecks.com 8th 11-2-1 Pyke, Bloodharbor Ripper by Mirru; riftbound.gg lists Pyke in Top 8 (11-2-1); yomis-place #8.

notes: Factor won the Hartford Regional Qualifier on Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman, defeating bsweitz's Diana, Scorn of the Moon in the final, and with that result Master Yi became the only legend to take three regional wins in the Unleashed season while Diana fell to one win across four finals. The 1,954-player field, the largest North American qualifier of the set, also sent Ezreal into the Top 4 and filled the rest of the Top 8 with two more Diana pilots alongside Lux, Annie, and Pyke.
